topics.purpose: Define the explicit schema/data-model binding of a UserModule definition or instance, including creation from an existing schema and selection/composition of declared domain modules.

semantics.schema_rule: UserModule references an explicit canonical schema identity/version.
semantics.existing_rule: Instance Editor may create a module/schema binding from an existing compatible schema without copying semantic ownership.
semantics.domain_rule: Selected Domain modules are explicit composition refs rather than inferred imports.
semantics.instance_rule: Per-instance data binding is explicit and follows local/relation semantics where DWH applies.
semantics.relation_rule: Cross-schema/domain relations require explicit canonical relation refs.
semantics.validation_rule: Schema compatibility and required relations validate before module activation.
semantics.ownership_rule: Binding a schema/domain does not transfer ownership of their semantics to the UserModule.

invariants.rule: UserModule identity, primary type, schema, instance identity and lifecycle state are explicit and never inferred from filesystem location or implementation behavior.

hard_gates.condition: schema semantics copied into module as duplicate authority
domain module inferred from directory/import name only
